title: Localizing and Editing the Goal Representation of a Vision-Language-Action Model: code
description: Code and analysis outputs for the paper Localizing and Editing the Goal Representation of a Vision-Language-Action Model (SPAIS Workshop at the 10th Conference on Robot Learning, CoRL 2026). The code studies OpenVLA-7B fine-tuned on LIBERO-Goal. It labels the goal that each closed-loop rollout executes, tests negated and redirected instructions, localizes the goal with activation patching, edits it with patches and steering vectors, and evaluates goal read-outs as runtime monitors.
